name: BTC-centered market-phase / risk appetite research-only daily diagnostic
data: Binance USDM perpetual futures closed daily bars. 2025-10 through 2026-09 derived from existing gapless verified R2 5m, October 1-17 2026 from Binance official daily 1d archive with CRC and optional upstream checksum. No unfinished Oct 18 bars.
cutoff: Daily close 00:00 UTC following date of bar; every field available at same cutoff, no lookahead.
indicators: BTC close vs 50- and 200-day SMA, 30-day slope of SMA200
BTC drawdown from 365-day rolling highest closed daily close; not all-time-high
BTC higher-high/higher-low comparison of previous versus latest 30-day windows
alt breadth fraction six alt pairs outperforming BTC over last 30 closed daily days
primaryPhaseRule: Bull-price-trend iff BTC > SMA200, SMA200 slope 30d positive, BTC 90d return >0; when close >200 and slope + but rolling drawdown >=25% label RECOVERY_NOT_CONFIRMED; bear-price-trend iff BTC < SMA200, slope 30d negative and BTC 90d return negative; close < SMA200 and 90d positive=RECOVERY_NOT_CONFIRMED; else CONSOLIDATION_OR_TRANSITION. These are proposed rules, not calibrated probabilities.
riskRule: 4 price-only votes: BTC above SMA50 and 30d BTC return positive +1 (both negative -1, mixed zero); ETH/BTC 30d positive +1 else -1; among six alts >=4 outperform BTC +1, <=2 -1, else 0; among six alts >=4 have positive USD 30d +1, <=2 -1, else 0. score >=3 RISK_ON_PRICE_PROXY, <=-2 RISK_OFF_PRICE_PROXY, else MIXED_PRICE_PROXY. Neither ETF nor policy rates are silently incorporated.
gating: Historical archive SHA integrity R2 metadata quality full
Oct 2026 official daily files available for every day 1..17; no gaps
Same exact 1d cutoff across eight assets, no partial current day
No missing data: status INCOMPLETE and no confident stage
No change to existing research histories or production detector
limitations: Current research derived from ONE futures venue and not a trading price or multi-venue NAV quote
Latest closed UTC day 17 Oct not live 18 Oct tick
Risk-on/off price proxy not macro liquidity, ETF flows, options or on-chain causality
Rules fixed here before v7.9 calculation, but developed after prior 2020-26 research; NOT OOS-tested
Need prospective and walk-forward validation plus point-in-time historical market breadth / macro to upgrade
No authority to alter futures, risk, portfolio, NAV or generate trades
